I'm interested in starting a discussion to build a simple checks and balances system for mods. What would it look like to have a system of anonymous users who can be held accountable for their actions?

My idea is to have an executive mod who gets voated on every 1-2 years. All submods who can be voated out after a request from the executive or majority voat from the subscribers. Finally an admin group who can hear an appeal from the community in cases of special circumstance.

Immediately, this idea seems prone to popularism and subscriber inflation in order to tip the voat (though hopefully the admin group would dissuade that). So, outside of technical limitations or the dirty details, what kind of system would be able to create accountability in an anonymous community?
